skill.name: slack-bot-builder
skill.description: Build Slack apps with the Slack Bolt framework across Python, JavaScript, and Java. Covers Block Kit, commands, events, OAuth installation, and Workflow Builder integration.
skill.summary: Guides production-minded Slack app development with Bolt, Block Kit, events, commands, and OAuth.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Slack apps require secure event handling, OAuth flows, and polished interactive UI. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Bolt patterns, Block Kit layouts, commands, events, and installation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains Bolt app setup for Python, JavaScript, and Java.
Shows patterns for Slack messages, slash commands, modals, and event handlers.
Summarizes Block Kit layout limits and builder usage.
Outlines OAuth installation flows, scopes, and token storage concerns.
Highlights production practices such as fast acknowledgements and minimum scopes.
limitations: Examples are partial templates and may require completion before use.
It does not provision Slack apps, secrets, scopes, or deployment infrastructure.
It does not validate generated code against a live Slack workspace.
Security storage choices must be adapted to each production environment.

use_cases.title: Launch a Workspace Bot
use_cases.description: Create a Slack bot that handles messages, commands, and interactive modals for an internal workspace.

use_cases.title: Design Incident Workflows
use_cases.description: Build Block Kit alerts with severity details, action buttons, and clear acknowledgement flows.

use_cases.title: Plan Public App Installation
use_cases.description: Map OAuth scopes, installation storage, and workspace-specific token handling for a distributed Slack app.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Bot
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a basic Slack Bolt app that replies to hello messages. Use Python and explain the required environment variables.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Block Kit Alert
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Block Kit message for incident notifications with severity, service, owner, and action buttons. Keep text within Slack limits.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Slash Command Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a slash command workflow that opens a ticket modal, validates required fields, and acknowledges the command quickly.

prompt_templates.title: Plan OAuth for Many Workspaces
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a multi-workspace OAuth installation flow for a public Slack app. Include scopes, token storage, state validation, and rollout risks.

output_examples.input: Create a slash command for support tickets.
output_examples.output: A workflow outline with command acknowledgement, modal fields, submission handling, and secure storage notes.

output: Header with incident severity and title.
Fields for service, owner, status, and reported time.
Action buttons for acknowledgement and escalation.

output_examples.input: Review OAuth setup for a public Slack app.
output_examples.output: A production checklist covering minimal scopes, workspace token storage, state validation, and installation recovery paths.

best_practices: Store Slack tokens in environment variables or a secret manager, never in source control.
Acknowledge Slack commands and events within three seconds before long processing.
Request only the Slack scopes required for the current workflow.
anti_patterns: Hardcoding bot tokens, signing secrets, or OAuth client secrets in generated code.
Requesting broad Slack scopes before a feature needs them.
Using Socket Mode as the default for production public apps without deployment review.

faq.question: Which Slack frameworks does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It focuses on Slack Bolt patterns for Python, JavaScript, and Java.

faq.question: Can it create Block Kit layouts?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides message, modal, and Home tab layouts using Slack Block Kit concepts.

faq.question: Does it handle OAuth installation flows?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains scopes, installation storage, and workspace-specific token handling.

faq.question: Does it deploy the Slack app?
faq.answer: No. It helps design and generate app patterns, but deployment remains your responsibility.

faq.question: How should secrets be managed?
faq.answer: Use environment variables or a secret manager, and avoid storing secrets in source control.

faq.question: Can it support production Slack apps?
faq.answer: Yes, when you add production storage, observability, deployment, and Slack app configuration.
